verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is a search data service that agents call as a tool. It is not an agent or host that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only the server role (the official Brave Search MCP server and guides for using it in Claude Desktop and similar clients), which is a different story and does not make the MCP-client axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
